intent_summary: Agents can analyze a request, page through its findings, and retrieve supporting samples, assessments, readiness, and relationship lineage.

criteria.criterion: The analyze tool returns a compact headline, finding preview, and run ID for subsequent evidence requests.
criteria.notes: The conversion manual call returns a relationship headline, preview, counts, readiness, and session-scoped run ID.

criteria.criterion: list_findings pages through cases, candidates, episodes, patterns, and data-quality findings.
criteria.notes: Cases, early candidates, episodes, patterns, and quality findings feed a bounded page; relationship episode regression verifies schema 1.1 pagination.

criteria.criterion: get_evidence exposes the selected finding's numerical support and relationship source lineage.
criteria.notes: Manual drilldown returns observed 8/130 versus expected 0.1 and source indexes orders=14 and qualified_visits=14.

criteria.criterion: Unavailable latest evidence and non-triggering early candidates remain visible, while large pattern sample sets are paginated.
criteria.notes: Passing tests retain short-history and inapplicable-method candidates plus unavailable latest evidence, while pattern samples are paginated.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent re-inspected declared implementation references and criterion evidence in the current session after the outcome-title and deliverable-lane refactor.
